title: Port STL format detection and ASCII continuation
scope: Port parseSTL and parseAscii faithfully, including exact-size binary precedence for solid headers, fallback count, TextDecoder, ECMAScript whitespace/parseFloat semantics and refusals. Integrate the binary decoder without silently omitting ASCII.
acceptance: Pinned original/native/browser-Wasm comparisons cover binary/ASCII detection, malformed/short input, ignored trailers and float32 output.
Explicit limits and bounded errors; helper progress behavior remains covered.
open_items: Do not implement only a binary early return and call the full dispatcher ported.
Preserve JS parseFloat prefix handling and Unicode whitespace rather than substituting Rust parse without comparison.
